keys.name: paper
keys.pose: A white page and nothing on it: she stands before the paper with her arms down while Clawd holds a crayon out.
keys.changes: A white page and nothing on it: she stands before the paper with her arms down while Clawd holds a crayon out.

keys.name: take
keys.pose: The right hand opens and closes on the crayon Clawd holds out: a tool is given.
keys.changes: The right hand opens and closes on the crayon Clawd holds out: a tool is given.

keys.name: draw
keys.pose: The crayon raised, she draws the first sweep of a stalk in the air.
keys.changes: The crayon raised, she draws the first sweep of a stalk in the air.

keys.name: draw-b
keys.pose: The second and third sweeps: the arm crosses the other way and the line stays where it was drawn.
keys.changes: The second and third sweeps: the arm crosses the other way and the line stays where it was drawn.

keys.name: real
keys.pose: The lines fill and a real stalk stands there, its leaf opening: both hands come open at once.
keys.changes: The lines fill and a real stalk stands there, its leaf opening: both hands come open at once.

keys.name: carry
keys.pose: She lifts the stalk like a lantern and turns to the edge of the paper, where the lines begin.
keys.changes: She lifts the stalk like a lantern and turns to the edge of the paper, where the lines begin.

keys.name: reduce
keys.pose: Everything is lines now; she walks on with the stalk held in front of her.
keys.changes: Everything is lines now; she walks on with the stalk held in front of her.

keys.name: reroute
keys.pose: She steps aside as Codex strides past to take the lead, the stalk held close.
keys.changes: She steps aside as Codex strides past to take the lead, the stalk held close.

keys.name: grid
keys.pose: A dark grid with lit edges: she stops, the stalk at her side, and looks where Codex points.
keys.changes: A dark grid with lit edges: she stops, the stalk at her side, and looks where Codex points.

keys.name: join
keys.pose: The stalk goes down against the other piece: she leans in with the arm out, and holds.
keys.changes: The stalk goes down against the other piece: she leans in with the arm out, and holds.

keys.name: run
keys.pose: Her hands come away and she steps back to watch the chain run, arms down.
keys.changes: Her hands come away and she steps back to watch the chain run, arms down.

keys.name: return
keys.pose: The frame stands ahead as a window with home in it: she steps toward it, one arm out.
keys.changes: The frame stands ahead as a window with home in it: she steps toward it, one arm out.
